items.q: What is the spine of Ondrej's current setup?
items.a: **Interfaces → subscriptions → self-hosted cloud agents → harnesses → skills → rapid-fire ops.** Main UI is **BB**; daily terminal is Ghostty + **Herder**. Never pay **API list price** — stack OpenCode Go ($10) plus Codex / Claude / Cursor by budget.

items.q: Why own a cheap VPS instead of vendor cloud agents?
items.a: Local agents die on laptop close. Vendor cloud = **lock-in + data exposure**. Cited Cursor share of *merged* PRs from cloud agents: ~**10–15%** → approaching **~60%** in H2 2026. First local agent does the DevOps in **plain English**.

items.q: What is the human job in this workflow?
items.a: **Taste and decisions** (ask-then-build, ADRs), not typing. One **cross-model review**, never recursive. Sub-agents only when **you** pick the model. Worktrees only at **15–30+** parallel agents. YOLO only behind **guardrails**.

items.q: How does he route models from use, not Twitter?
items.a: **Plan / new project: Fable.** Nasty bug: **GPT 5.6 Soul**. Default chat: **Grok 4.6**. Frontend: **Kimi K3**. Build with Fable, review with Soul, fix the worst, push. Recursive Fable→GPT→Fable **invents imaginary bugs**.
